slides.title: 97 of every 100 visitors leave without buying.
slides.body: None of them tell you why. These are the 6 reasons that show up again and again.

slides.title: The delivery fee shows up late
slides.body: Extra costs at checkout are the biggest reason carts get dropped. Show the fee on the product page.

slides.title: Reviews sit too low
slides.body: If the proof is six scrolls down, most shoppers never reach it. Put the star rating right next to the price.

slides.title: Photo 1 has no sense of size
slides.body: "How big is it?" is the first question. Show the product in a hand, or next to something familiar.

slides.title: The price has no reason
slides.body: ₹1,499 needs a why: what's inside, how long it lasts, what it costs per day.

slides.title: Only one way to pay
slides.body: In India, no COD or UPI at checkout loses buyers at the very last step.

slides.title: No reason to buy today
slides.body: A delivery date, stock left, a gift box. Give the scroller a reason not to save it for later.

slides.title: CHECK THESE 6 TONIGHT
items: Show delivery fee on the page
slides.foot: Screenshot this. Send it to whoever runs your store.

slides.body: and 7 AI shoppers check your page for all 6. Free, in your DMs.
